ideas.pitch: An automated benchmark and mock test generator specifically built to drill candidates on Java core concepts, Computer Networks MCQs, and DSA coding challenges under tight time limits.
ideas.title: JavaOA-Sim
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly mirrors the exact structure of the HexaCode assessment platform, appealing to judges looking for tools that help students ace online placement rounds.

ideas.pitch: A specialized practice environment combining dynamic Computer Networks protocol simulation problems with Java multi-threading puzzles.
ideas.title: NetCode-Trainer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the specific domain knowledge requirements of the contest (Computer Networks + Java) rather than generic programming problems.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight browser extension and sandbox monitor that simulates high-stakes online assessment pressure while tracking memory limits and execution time for custom Java algorithms.
ideas.title: OA-RuntimeGuard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on the strict performance metrics and time constraints emphasized in high-stakes OA placement screenings.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first algorithmic problem solver and template generator optimized for rapid syntax recall in Java during competitive coding rounds.
ideas.title: AlgoMatrix-Java
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the exact time-management bottleneck of coding under the clock in a 60-minute assessment window.

ideas.pitch: A peer-to-peer mock assessment simulator where solo candidates can generate randomized 9-question OA papers combining Java, CN, and DSA.
ideas.title: PeerOA-Evaluator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with individual participation constraints by offering self-paced simulation for single-player assessment preparation.
